name: jev-gates
description: Composable, three-valued semantic logic circuits powered by JEV.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js run examples/support-triage.json --input examples/support-input.json --mock examples/support-answers.json
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.workbench: npm run build && npm --prefix ui ci && npm --prefix ui run build && node dist/workbench-server.js
scripts.workbench:build: npm run build && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.research:demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js research-demo
scripts.research:eval: npm run build && node dist/cli.js evaluate
scripts.research:smoke: npm run build && node dist/cli.js live-smoke
